infrastructure.mcp_protocol: HTTP SSE without Bearer prefix. Accept: application/json, text/event-stream (REQUIRED - 400 error if only text/event-stream)
infrastructure.mcp_notes: Do NOT use 'Bearer' prefix for Authorization header. Accept header MUST include both application/json and text/event-stream
infrastructure.github_mcp_tools: issue_read(method: get/get_comments, param: issue_number), pull_request_read(pullNumber, method: get), list_issues, list_pull_requests, search_pull_requests, search_issues
infrastructure.rebase_note: For rebasing old PR branches: git checkout origin/<branch> -b <branch> && git rebase origin/master
infrastructure.safeoutputs_create_pr: create_pull_request returns {result:success, patch:{path,size,lines}} on success - branch push and PR creation happen AFTER run ends
infrastructure.safeoutputs_branch_push_timing: Branch push and PR creation are async - PR does not appear in GitHub during the run, only after the workflow completes
infrastructure.shell_injection_warning: Do NOT use here-doc (<<'EOF') pattern when embedding Python with subprocess that references shell vars
infrastructure.mcp_github_list_tools: tool name is 'list_issues' not 'list_issues'; issue tool is 'issue_read' (not 'get_issue'); PR tool is 'pull_request_read'
infrastructure.git_rebase_editor: Use GIT_EDITOR=true git rebase --continue to avoid interactive editor during rebase
infrastructure.rebase_conflict_note: When rebasing with conflict, git rebase --abort first before retrying
infrastructure.success_response_format: push_to_pull_request_branch success is in nested JSON: text field contains {result:success,...}
